name: Hypercam [UPDATE]
desc:
Hypercam is a slow-paced tactical shooter inspired by 'Unrecord' and 'Bodycam,' set in the EFT universe.

LATEST UPDATE:
- Levels
- UI Overhaul
- Respawn time reduced to 5 seconds.

A big update is coming soon!
(Shutdown = Update)

✅ Compatible with: Mobile, Tablet, Console, and PC!

--- CONTROLS ---
[PC / CONTROLLER]

Voice Lines: G
Laser: H / Button Y
Flashlight: J / DPad Up
Firemode: V / Button B
Alt Aim: T / R3 (Right Stick Click)
Lean: Q/E / DPad Left/Right
Crouch: C / DPad Down (Tap once for crouch, twice for prone)
Stand: X / DPad Down (Tap three times from crouch/prone)

--- TAGS ---
FPS, Bodycam, Unrecorded, ACS, Realistic, Gun, Shooter, Randomizer, Realism, Weapon, EFT, Tarkov, Milsim, SWAT, War, CSGO

scripts.title: keyless silent aim hub
scripts.features:
hypercam hub, rayfield ui

combat:
- silent aim, hold mouse1 and it hits whoever's closest to ur cursor in the fov. team check + vis check so u dont shoot ur own guys thru walls
- triggerbot, put ur crosshair on someone and it shoots by itself. has its own team check, delay and radius sliders. crosshair goes red when its locked on
- test fire button if u wanna check if its hitting
- speed bypass, slider up to 60. doesnt touch walkspeed so the anticheat doesnt flag it, stops clean no sliding
- hitbox expander, makes enemy heads big with a size slider

visuals:
- esp with boxes, skeleton, names, hp bars, distance, tracers. team check hides ur team

gun:
- fast reload, skips the reload anim so u reload instantly, doesnt touch ammo
- no spread, no recoil

crosshair tab, 5 styles, click to put on click again to take off. size gap and color sliders

configs tab, save/load/delete ur setups

misc has diagnostics if something breaks and unload
